explication: This GitHub Action creates contribution-graph commits in a configured repository. The workflow reads and parses environment settings, prepares a local clone or fresh repository, selects eligible dates and randomized commit counts, creates empty dated commits, then pushes them to the configured branch. The source excerpts show the orchestration and random helper; README documents the supported configuration options. External GitHub Actions inputs and the Git remote are represented separately.
